messages:
Sam: Following up from today's postmortem: we listed action items on the scheduler stall that repeatedly caused backlog amplification overnight. Need owners, JIRA links, and 2/6/12w checkpoints.

Lina: I can own the RCA for the scheduler stall and work on a short-term mitigation (reduce high-priority pod churn). Will open a ticket.

Omar: I'll take the telemetry/alerting piece — need to add a composite alert for queue-growth + CPU steal.

Priya: I'll own the rollout gating and the automated canary to catch stall regressions.

DevOps-bot: New JIRA created: RINF-4120 — "Investigate scheduler stall causing overnight backlog amplification" assigned to Lina. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4120

Lina: Created subtask RINF-4120-1: "collect scheduler traces + reproduce locally". Tagging Omar for metric correlation.

Omar: I'll draft RINF-4121 for alerts/dashboard. Proposed composite alert: queue_length_increase > 50% over 10m AND cpu_steal_rate > 5% for 5m. Will post queries.

Priya: I'll create RINF-4122 for canary/gating and mark it blocked-by RINF-4120 until RCA confirms mitigations.

Sam: RACI proposal:
- Responsible: Lina (scheduler RCA)
- Accountable: Sam (remediation delivery lead)
- Consulted: Omar, Priya
- Informed: eng-oncall, infra-team
No objections, lock it?

Omar: fine. I'll coordinate with infra to add the cpu_steal metric if missing.

Lina: Quick note — I saw repeated stall windows at 02:00-03:30 UTC across three days. Added trace snippet to RINF-4120.

Sam: Action summary:
- RINF-4120: scheduler stall RCA — Owner: Lina (R).
- RINF-4121: telemetry & alerts — Owner: Omar (C). ETA Tue EOD.
- RINF-4122: canary + gating — Owner: Priya (A). Target: 2w runbook, 6w automation.

Priya: I'll calendar 48h triage and the 2/6/12w checkpoints.

Omar: ETA for dashboard draft: Tue COB. Will include historical spike correlate with config changes.

Lina: I'll start the local repro and post updates in RINF-4120.

DevOps-bot: Subtask created: RINF-4120-1 "reproduce scheduler stall in staging" assigned to Lina.

Sam: Please update JIRAs with PR links and tag me as watcher. We'll meet 48h after RINF-4121 draft to sign-off thresholds.

Lina: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Omar: Will post queries and draft alerts here when ready.

Priya: Will draft the canary checklist and attach to RINF-4122.

Sam: Closing thread for now — reopen if priorities shift.
